title: Great Skin Instant Glow Serum with Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid

specifications.ingredientPreferences: crueltyFree, antioxidants, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hyaluronic Acid✓ Vegan✓ Good for: Uneven Texture✓ Best for Dry, Combo, Normal Skin✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Hydrating✓ Niacinamide
What it is: A lightweight, bi-phase serum that quickly hydrates and visibly plumps skin while leaving it looking calmer, brighter, and more even.
Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Dryness and Dullness

Formulation: Serum

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Hyaluronic Acid Complex: Targets multiple layers of skin to lock in hydration for all-day moisture.
- Niacinamide: Visibly brightens skin and refines texture for a smooth, glowing complexion.
- Cacao Seed Extract: Caffeine-rich antioxidant stimulates blood flow for a plump effect.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Shake well. After cleansing and before moisturizer, warm serum in hands and press into skin. -Can be applied after your other active serums to lock in hydration and visibly improve texture over time.
-Applies like an essence with the strength of a serum. Wears well with makeup or on its own.
-For dry skin: Use three pumps.
-For normal skin: Use two pumps.
-For combination/oily skin: Use one to two pumps
Ingredients+
-Hyaluronic Acid: Targets multiple layers of skin to lock in hydration for all day moisture.
-Niacinamide: Helps to visibly brighten skin and refines texture for a smooth, visibly glowing complexion.
-Cacao Seed Extract: Caffeine-rich antioxidant helps to stimulate blood flow for a plump effect.

Water, Propanediol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Isononyl Isononanoate, 1,2-Hexanediol, Niacinamide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Coptis Japonica Root Extract, Theobroma Cacao (Cocoa) Seed Extract, Tocopherol, Butylene Glycol, Pentylene Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Dextrin, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate.

The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
